open_points.subject: IdentityInputRejected ownership
open_points.question: Must IdentityInputRejected be defined locally, or must the statement that no owned local classes are required change?

open_points.subject: authenticate_staff email verification
open_points.text: - authenticate_staff: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST normalize email, accept only an account whose status is StaffStatus.ACTIVE with a matching password, deciding nothing on email_verified_at, issue a hashed fixed-expiry session, audit success or concealed failure, and never reveal which check failed.
open_points.other_text: A transition into active from pending_verification MUST also record email_verified_at at that same captured timestamp: while the self-service verification challenge has no storage, the administrator performing the activation is what vouches for the address, and an account left unverified could never authenticate.
open_points.question: May an active account authenticate regardless of email_verified_at, or must an account without email_verified_at be unable to authenticate?
